title: Synthesis of nanostructured cubic-phase SnO2 thin film for trace-level CO gas sensing
core_idea: Develop a fabrication route to stabilize nanostructured cubic-phase SnO2 thin films using a simple sol–gel process followed by spin coating, confirm the cubic phase by XRD and TEM (a phase usually reported at high pressures/temperatures), and integrate these films into a low-voltage, ambient-condition MOS gas sensor for selective CO detection while using DFT simulations to probe CO adsorption/desorption energetics on the cubic versus tetragonal phases.
tldr: The work aims to produce and characterize cubic-phase SnO2 thin films via sol–gel and spin coating, verify their structure with XRD/TEM, and apply them in a room-temperature MOS device for selective CO sensing, with DFT used to understand adsorption/desorption behavior.
